2026_02_NO_BAL.headline: Saints face a Baltimore defense built to speed up young decisions
2026_02_NO_BAL.paragraph1: New Orleans turns from an overtime loss in Detroit to a road game against a Baltimore team that opened with a decisive win. The Saints’ current team update says preparation has shifted fully to the Ravens, while Baltimore’s opponent breakdown identifies Tyler Shough and a reworked New Orleans skill group as the central offensive question. The Saints need early-down efficiency to protect their young quarterback from obvious passing situations; the Ravens want their pressure and coverage structure to make Shough solve the game quickly.
2026_02_NO_BAL.model_rationale: Baltimore’s ability to force Tyler Shough into long-yardage decisions determines whether the Ravens can dictate tempo or New Orleans can keep its offense balanced and manageable.
